summary: Ragnar Locker was a targeted double-extortion operation active from late 2019 until an international takedown in October 2023, which seized its leak site and servers and arrested a suspected developer in Paris. The FBI linked it to at least 52 critical-infrastructure victims. Operators got in through exposed RDP (brute-forced or purchased credentials) and, per FBI IOCs, internet-facing Confluence servers. They deployed the locker through Group Policy and msiexec inside a stripped-down Windows XP VirtualBox guest so that host security tools could not see the encryption. The malware stopped MSP remote-administration services and deleted shadow copies first.
uniqueTraits: Ran the encryptor inside a MicroXP (Windows XP SP3) VirtualBox 3.0.4 guest and encrypted host drives through shared folders

Deployed through a GPO task that ran msiexec to silently install an unsigned MSI fetched from a remote server, then registered VirtualBox components with regsvr32/rundll32 and created the VBoxDrv service with sc.exe
Stopped services used by managed service providers to remotely administer networks before encryption
Mounted unassigned volumes (SetVolumeMountPointA) so they would be encrypted too; extension .RGNR_<hash of NetBIOS name>

chain.procedure: Gets in through exposed RDP, using brute-forced or purchased credentials.

atomics.testName: Brute Force Credentials of single Active Directory domain users via SMB
atomics.note: Brute-forces a single domain account over SMB. It exercises password-guessing detections; internet-facing RDP brute force has to be tested at the perimeter.

chain.procedure: FBI IOCs include actor IPs that were accessing victims' Confluence servers (2021), which points to internet-facing Confluence as an entry point. No CVE is named.
chain.noAtomicReason: No local atomic exploits Confluence, and the CVE is not identified. Cover this with web-server and Confluence process-ancestry analytics (java.exe/tomcat spawning shells).

chain.procedure: Moves tooling with PuTTY's PSCP (FBI IOC 'IP involved in PSCP activity') and uses an updt32.exe proxy implant.

atomics.testName: Remote File Copy using PSCP
atomics.note: Copies files with PuTTY PSCP, the tool named in the FBI IOCs.

chain.procedure: Calls GetLocaleInfoW and terminates if the locale is Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian, Kazakh or another CIS language.

atomics.testName: Discover System Language by Windows API Query
atomics.note: Queries the system language through the Windows API, like the GetLocaleInfoW check.

atomics.testName: Discover System Language by Registry Query
atomics.note: Language discovery through a registry query.

chain.procedure: Reads the MachineGuid, the OS product name and the user and computer names, then hashes them into a unique victim identifier.

atomics.testName: Windows MachineGUID Discovery
atomics.note: Reads the MachineGuid from the registry.

atomics.testName: Discover OS Product Name via Registry
atomics.note: Reads the OS ProductName from the registry.

chain.procedure: Enumerates attached disks with GetLogicalDrives/DeviceIoControl and mounts unassigned volumes with SetVolumeMountPointA so they are encrypted too.

atomics.testName: Peripheral Device Discovery via fsutil
atomics.note: Discovers drives and volumes with fsutil.

atomics.testName: Local Storage Discovery via PSDrive
atomics.note: Discovers local storage with Get-PSDrive.

chain.techniqueName: Domain or Tenant Policy Modification: Group Policy Modification
chain.procedure: Pushes the payload out with a Group Policy task that runs msiexec on target machines.

atomics.testName: LockBit Black - Modify Group policy settings -cmd
atomics.note: Modifies Group Policy settings from the command line, generating the GPO-change telemetry that malicious GPO deployment produces.

chain.procedure: msiexec silently installs an unsigned ~122 MB MSI downloaded from a remote server. The package bundles Sun xVM VirtualBox 3.0.4 and the micro.vdi disk image.

atomics.testName: Msiexec.exe - Execute Remote MSI file
atomics.note: Runs a remote MSI with msiexec.

atomics.testName: Msiexec.exe - Execute Local MSI file with an embedded EXE
atomics.note: Runs a local MSI with an embedded EXE.

chain.procedure: A batch script registers the VirtualBox COM components (VBoxC.dll and others) with regsvr32 and rundll32.

atomics.testName: Regsvr32 Silent DLL Install Call DllRegisterServer
atomics.note: Silently registers a DLL with regsvr32 /s through DllRegisterServer.

atomics.testName: Regsvr32 local DLL execution
atomics.note: Runs a local DLL with regsvr32.

chain.techniqueName: Create or Modify System Process: Windows Service
chain.procedure: Creates and starts the VirtualBox driver service (VBoxDrv) with sc.exe.

atomics.testName: Service Installation CMD
atomics.note: Installs a service with sc create.

atomics.testName: Execute a Command as a Service
atomics.note: Runs a command as a service through sc.

chain.procedure: Boots a MicroXP v0.82 (Windows XP SP3) VirtualBox guest that holds the 49 KB locker. Host drives are mapped into the guest as shared folders so encryption happens inside the VM, out of sight of host security tools.

atomics.testName: Register Portable Virtualbox
atomics.note: Registers a portable VirtualBox install (drivers and services) as Ragnar Locker did.

atomics.testName: Create and start VirtualBox virtual machine
atomics.note: Creates and starts a VirtualBox VM from the command line.

chain.procedure: Tries to terminate or stop processes and services that belong to endpoint security products.

atomics.testName: Stop and Remove Arbitrary Security Windows Service
atomics.note: Stops and removes a security service.

atomics.testName: Disable Arbitrary Security Windows Service
atomics.note: Disables a security service.

chain.procedure: Iterates through running services and stops the ones MSPs use to remotely administer networks (remote-management agents), along with database and business-application services that would hold file locks.

atomics.testName: Windows - Stop service using net.exe
atomics.note: Stops a service with net stop.

atomics.testName: Windows - Stop service using Service Controller
atomics.note: Stops a service with sc stop.

chain.procedure: Silently deletes all volume shadow copies with 'vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet' and 'wmic shadowcopy delete'.

atomics.testName: Windows - Delete Volume Shadow Copies
atomics.note: vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet.

atomics.testName: Windows - Delete Volume Shadow Copies via WMI
atomics.note: wmic shadowcopy delete.

chain.procedure: Encrypts files on local and mapped drives using a folder exclusion list, appends .RGNR_<ID> and drops a RAGNAR_LOCKER .txt ransom note. The leak site was seized in October 2023.

atomics.testName: PureLocker Ransom Note
atomics.note: Drops a ransom note artifact. The VM-hosted encryption is not reproduced.
